usage: This is the most common and universal way to say goodbye in Moroccan Darija. It is used in both formal and informal situations, regardless of the gender or number of people being addressed. You will hear it everywhere from shops and taxis to family gatherings.

variants.label: casual (to a man)
variants.note: Used informally among friends when parting ways.

variants.label: casual (to a woman)
variants.note: The feminine form of telling someone to take care of themselves.

variants.label: casual (to a group)
variants.note: Used when saying goodbye to a group of friends or family members.

variants.label: respectful / parting
variants.note: Often said to shopkeepers, workers, or anyone doing a task as you leave.

examples.english: I have to go now, goodbye.
